summary: Iteration 10: verified 3 new enhancements + regression after email_utils.py extraction. 20/20 backend pytest cases pass. (1) 2FA failed-code lockout: 5 wrong TOTP codes on throwaway operator -> HTTP 423 (locked), 6th still 423, admin DELETE /api/auth/lockouts/{email} unlocks, correct TOTP then logs in. (2) Balance ledger month filter: no month=50 entries, month=2026-10=49 entries (subset, all in Oct 2026), month=2020-01=0 entries, invalid month=2026-13 returns 400 (same for /reports/balance-ledger). (3) 2FA security emails: enable/disable return 200 < 5s with notify_security scheduled via asyncio.create_task; failed-2FA login also returns 401/423 fast. Frontend /ledger range select + month input work: switching to 按月份 enables the month input and live-filters the table; 2020-01 shows '暂无资金流水'. Regression: admin/merchant/agent/operator login, GET /orders, /balance/ledger, /operators, /audit-logs, POST /auth/2fa/setup (returns qr) — all 200. Admin ajin53193@gmail.com left with 2FA DISABLED (test_zzz_admin_2fa_disabled_at_end asserts totp_enabled!=true).

minor.issue: Emergent Resend email provider returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) during repeated 2FA enable tests; notify_security correctly catches via try/except and logs 'security email failed (enable): 429 Too Many Requests' as a WARNING. Response unaffected (still 200, <5s). Not a bug — fire-and-forget contract honored — but main agent should know logs will contain these warnings under load.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 2389 lines — strongly recommend splitting (auth, 2fa, orders, settlements, ledger, operators) now that email was successfully extracted into email_utils.py.

notify_security re-raises nothing but logs as WARNING on any failure (incl. 429 rate limit). Consider downgrading expected transient errors (429) to DEBUG, or add simple in-process rate-limit so test loops don't spam Resend.

record_login_failure is correctly called on bad TOTP code so 2FA brute-force uses the same 5-fail/15-min counter as password — good. However, successful password + bad TOTP does NOT clear prior password-fail attempts until a full success; verify this is intentional (today it increments on top of password fails which is actually safer).
balance_ledger month-filter uses iso string comparison on created_at — works because iso() is lexicographically sortable, but a code comment would help future readers.
No account DELETE endpoint — each test run creates a persistent operator (test_2fa_*@demo.com). Consider admin DELETE /api/accounts/{id} for cleanup.

seed_data_creation: Per run: 1 throwaway operator account with 2FA enabled. Lockout rows cleared post-test. Admin 2FA cleared post-test by the SecurityEmails test flow (via test disable+re-enable only on throwaway op; admin never touched for 2FA enable).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration10.py adds coverage on top of test_iteration9.py. Uses pyotp. IMPORTANT: use LOWERCASE emails for test accounts (login lowercases, so lockout identifier is lowercase; DELETE /auth/lockouts/{email} is case-sensitive). pytest auto-runs with -n 2 --dist loadscope — classes share workers. Final test test_zzz_admin_2fa_disabled_at_end is the admin safeguard; keep it. Backend may log 'security email failed' WARNINGS when Resend rate-limits — this is OK and does not break responses.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no production bugs. One test-authoring bug encountered during this iteration: initial throwaway email used TEST_<uuid> uppercase; server.py lowercases on login so lockout identifier was stored lowercase, making admin DELETE /auth/lockouts/{TEST_..@demo.com} a no-op and keeping the account locked. Fixed by using lowercase emails.
